notes.title: Quick Update: Adds Tooltips
notes.content:
Adds some extra tooltips to explain some things on screen. You can now mouse over the Keyword dots, RAM, and ALT+K/ALT+I to see what they do. 
[list]
[*] The dots above your Keywords are the number of Keywords you can type at once before pressing ENTER to get a refresh.
[*] RAM boosts base attack power.
[*] ALT+K and ALT+I are special attacks that respectively kill and stun the active threat.
[/list]
